dialogs.title: Profile editor
dialogs.text:
Profile editor
done
Got it
Basic details

Complete the information used on your profile.

For a regular profile, name, birthday, city, height, physique, gender, and languages are required. The short About text, work, and school entries add useful context.

manage_accounts
Profile photos

Manage images in a separate panel.

Use the edit action on the profile card to open Images. Add, reorder, replace, or remove photos, then return to the main panel before saving.

add_photo_alternate
Details and visibility

Add optional details and choose who can see them.

Add experience, lifestyle, values, and interests as needed. The header controls the overall profile status, while visibility icons beside supported details choose Public, Friends, Hosts, or Private.

tune
Save your profile

Use the checkmark when you are finished.

The checkmark saves your changes and closes the editor. Closing the main panel without saving does not submit the changes.

save

dialogs.title: Contacts
dialogs.text:
Contacts
done
Got it
Saved contacts

Keep useful people easy to find.

Search your saved contacts by name. Create Contact lets you choose a member and add that person to this list.

Contact card

Open a profile or use a saved shortcut.

The card shows the person, city, and saved contact methods. The eye opens the profile; the chips and three-dot menu open phone, message, email, social, website, edit, or delete actions when available.

Edit contact methods

Change only the shortcuts saved in your contact list.

Edit adds, changes, or removes phone, email, messaging, social, and web links. It does not edit the person’s profile, and deleting the contact only removes the entry from your list.
